Game Overview

At its heart, Find the Mole is a casual game about embark on a thrilling mole-hunting adventure in a sunlit meadow. Test your speed and observation skills in a 150-second race to spot the hidden mole. Each successful find boosts your score, with a last-minute reveal adding an exciting twist. Are you quick enough to beat the clock?
